0.msg: Machina, do you... have my emblem?

1.msg: I found it just sitting there on a desk. Tsk. How could you just leave it, after working so hard to get it? Good thing I held on to it for you.

2.msg: Aww, thanks for taking care of it for me.

3.msg: No need to thank me. Just hand over the finder's fee of #b1,010,000 mesos#k and you'll get it right back.

5.msg: Oh yes. I think that's fair. It'll teach you to take better care of your things. You do have #b1,010,000 mesos#k, right?

no.0: Oh dear. You're going to give up on this precious emblem because of a measly #b1,010,000 mesos#k? I guess you wasted your time making it all the way to the Sanctuary of the Ancient Gods.

yes.0: Please get the mesos and come back to me.

default.0: Don't tell me that you don't have #b1,010,000 mesos#k... You're as irresponsible with your money as you are with your belongings. I can't enable that type of behavior. I'm sorry, but you won't get your emblem back until you can pay the finder's fee.

1.0: Here you go! Now, would you please try to keep better track of your stuff?
